title: Removed OAB 0.1 cross-origin protocol message
description: No instance is valid. OAB 0.2 removed the cross-origin message state machine; use link-envelope/1 or detached-datachannel/1.
$comment: This rejecting tombstone prevents a removed OAB 0.1 window message from being mistaken for a supported protocol message. OAB 0.2 uses profile-specific schemas instead.
